releaseNotes: Stock handling: an unknown scan can now be attached to an existing product (Attach to an existing product) instead of only creating a new one; from then on that barcode or QR code selects the product, in stock handling and in the count. The product page lists a product's scan codes with Remove. Seal cards are booked by serial, one scan per piece (they could not be booked before). A booking the server refuses now reads NOT booked with the reason.
